name: animestore
description: AnimeStore - Full Stack Anime E-Commerce App

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --prefix "[{name}]" --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --prefix "[{name}]" --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
